message.content:
Secretary framing: no material misrepresentation of my Round 2 positions.

**N1 — Headline.** Accept. Oracle-free fixed-λ leads; triple print; power clause inline. Condition: +27.05 is always labelled oracle-censored and never appears as the standalone public number. Operational P remains fixed-λ λ=1.

**N2 — Gate threshold.** Confirmed. Drop 4.42. Gate is one-sided Δ = skill(F5) − skill(curve) on common origins; threshold 1.96·SD_block(Δ), renamed a critical value, recomputed each refit; print the 80%-power MDE, Δ without the largest-contributing block, and Δ at starts 1953Q2/1960Q1.

**N3 — L_R.** Confirmed peak-only. Protocol text: L_R = max(18, max peak lag) for label maturity; separate trough-audit parameter for open-episode censoring, fixed before the first audit. Fable’s trough-flip concern does not bind: historical max trough lag 21 < maturity slack 30. I would change if a replay shows an actual `eligible_fit` flip at lag ≤ 30.

**O1 — Frequency.** Final: quarterly fit. The full monthly-vs-quarterly comparison is unpaired; 591 origins share 11/12 target months, effective samples ≈ 49 vs ≈ 50; the quarter-end thinned score 26.03 fails 26.05. Monthly steepens β −1.29 → −1.41 without independent information. Compromise: quarterly, no override language; record the thinned code reading as the executed gate; publish both readings; log monthly-fit P as an unscored column from 2027. **Veto:** monthly-primary from 2027 without a sealed summed-loss penalty normalisation and a sealed monthly configuration replay published before the refit.

**O2 — Content trigger.** Final: adopt restricted trigger — new positive labels/relabels only; negative maturation excluded. Compromise accepted: at most one content-triggered refit per new onset at the first matured positive absent from the manifest; later positives wait for September. Condition: the actual trigger regime is replayable and published in the ledger supplement; triggers never alter labels or censoring.

**O3 — EBP/Baa.** Final: accept the candidate text. Historical EBP sealed test is closed permanently; EBP stays a context line; future prospective-only evaluation sealed before any post-2027 onset, with no pre-2027 data as evidence. Baa remains closed. No veto.
